name: Badge
summary: A small count or dot marker — notification counts, unread dots; plus label chips and ribbons.
highlights: Notification counts, unread dots, label chips
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-badge> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. The DS V3 Badge is a family: `count` renders a number pill on the top-right of a wrapped child (capped by `overflowCount` as N+, kept at 0 with `showZero`); `dot` renders a bare marker in one of three colours (`status` strong, disabled or active); `color` overrides the count colour. For a standalone state label (Published, Failed) use the Status badge component. Shadow-DOM CSS themed only by --aha-* tokens; the pill scales in on a persistent node. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Count bubble
spec.value: height 18 · min-width 18 · radius pill · padding 0 6 · scales in

spec.label: On a child
spec.value: floats to the child's top-right, 1px container-colour ring

spec.label: Dot
spec.value: 8×8, no label. Colour by status: strong (default) icon-strong #1A1A1A, disabled icon-disabled #B5B5B5, active icon-active #E70E68

spec.label: Default colour
spec.value: count → error #1A1A1A; dot → strong #1A1A1A; ribbon → primary #E70E68. Vivid Pink count: status="primary" (white number on #E70E68)

spec.label: Overflow / zero
spec.value: count > overflowCount → N+; 0 hides unless showZero

spec.label: Ribbon
spec.value: corner banner over a wrapped card; 22px tall, radius 4, triangular fold; placement start/end

spec.label: Tone chip
spec.value: filled/tinted pill (radius pill, 22px); danger·success·positive·essential·pro·branding·primary-alt, each bound to an --aha token

spec.label: Plan chip
spec.value: preset (free·edu·essential·pro·enterprise); solid brand fill, cycle monthly/yearly; pro/enterprise lead with a crown

spec.label: Session chip
spec.value: "Session N" brand-accent pill; label from `session` / slotted text

spec.label: Clickable = link
spec.value: with `href` renders <a class="chip"> (native focusable link, animates on hover) — never a <button>; no href = plain <span>

props.name: count
props.desc: The number shown in the bubble; 0 hides it unless showZero

props.name: overflowCount
props.desc: Cap; above it renders as N+ (alias: max)

props.name: showZero
props.desc: Keep the bubble visible when count is 0

props.name: dot
props.desc: Render a bare marker, no number; colour from `status` (strong · disabled · active)

props.name: status
props.type: success | processing | error | warning | default | primary (count, ribbon) · strong | disabled | active (dot)
props.desc: Semantic colour of a count or ribbon; on a `dot` it picks one of three colours: strong, disabled, active

props.name: text
props.desc: Label for a ribbon, or a tone/plan/rank/session chip

props.name: color
props.desc: Custom colour overriding the semantic default

props.name: ribbon
props.desc: Wrap the slotted child (a card) with a corner ribbon banner; `text` is the label, colour from color/status (default primary)

props.name: placement
props.desc: Ribbon corner: end = top-right (default), start = top-left

props.name: tone
props.type: danger | success | positive | essential | pro | branding | primary-alt
props.desc: Filled/tinted LABEL chip; each tone binds bg + fg to an --aha-* token

props.name: plan
props.desc: Plan preset chip (solid brand fill); pro/enterprise lead with a crown glyph

props.name: cycle
props.desc: Appended to a plan chip's default label (e.g. "Pro · Yearly")

props.name: rank
props.desc: Leaderboard rank chip; medal-tinted (gold/silver/bronze) with a leading system-medal glyph

props.name: session
props.desc: Renders a "Session N" chip; the value is N (slotted content / `text` overrides the label)

props.name: href
props.desc: Makes a tone/plan/rank/session chip a clickable LINK — renders <a class="chip" href> (native focusable, animates on hover), never a <button>. Omit for a static <span> chip

whenToUse.when: a count or presence marker attached to another element (a bell, a tab, an avatar)
a standalone semantic state label (Published, Generating, Failed) in a list or header: use the Status badge, not Badge
a standalone label/keyword chip with text but no status semantics

opinion.note: A count/dot marks another element — wrap the element it belongs to so the pill anchors to its top-right. Keep counts meaningful; cap large numbers with overflowCount so the bubble stays small. A dot takes only strong, disabled or active. A standalone state label belongs to the Status badge component.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Badge component-set taxonomy: Badge/Count, Badge/Dot, Badge/Text, Badge/On-Icon, Badge/On-Image, Badge/Dot-On-Text, Badge/Ribbon — i.e. the family carries a count pill, a bare dot, placement over a wrapped icon/image/text child, AND a corner ribbon banner wrapping a card. antd Badge conventions supply the count sizing (18px bubble, 8×8 dot, 11/18 SemiBold), overflowCount N+, showZero, the count status set (success/processing/error/default/warning), and Badge.Ribbon (a corner banner, 22px tall, radius-xs on the outer corner, a darkened triangular fold, placement start/end, colour default primary). Token layer: count/dot default color-error, count status→color-success/warning/primary(processing)/text-tertiary(default), dot→icon-strong/icon-disabled/icon-active, ribbon default color-primary + radius-xs fold, radius-pill, text-inverse, bg-container ring. The measured component standard has no badge cell — a deliberate, documented extension, not a measured match.
